def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    yy,xx=q
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=8 and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
            colored=[(y,x) for y,x in comp if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored: continue
            sr0=min(y for y,x in colored); sr1=max(y for y,x in colored)
            sc0=min(x for y,x in colored); sc1=max(x for y,x in colored)
            sh,sw=sr1-sr0+1,sc1-sc0+1
            pat=[[grid[sr0+i][sc0+j] for j in range(sw)] for i in range(sh)]
            for y,x in comp:
                out[y][x]=pat[(y-sr0)%sh][(x-sc0)%sw]
    return out
